summary: setFullYear mutates the Date: replace local full year; month/date default from current local time; invalid receiver uses +0 as base; it returns the resulting millisecond time value.

target.notes: Reuse canonical ToNumber helpers/runtime as required by argument static types; preserve mutation only after the specified conversions/calculations.

semantics.coercion: ToNumber supplied arguments in specification order
semantics.description: replace local full year; month/date default from current local time; invalid receiver uses +0 as base

caveats: Explicit undefined is a supplied argument and ToNumber(undefined) is NaN; omitted optional arguments instead use current component defaults.
Local setters are DST-sensitive; elapsed milliseconds can differ from nominal component changes.
Unlike most component setters, FullYear setters use +0 as the base time when the receiver is Invalid Date, so they can recover it.

tests.name: Invalid Date can be recovered
tests.expected_behavior: prints false 2000; unlike most component setters, setFullYear uses +0 as its base when the receiver is invalid
